items.summary: New features PGXSExtension module — a single config-driven module for testing out-of-tree PGXS extensions, keyed by a pgxs_extensions hash in the config (one entry per extension). New test extensions no longer need their own bespoke .pm file. The existing BlackholeFDW, FileTextArrayFDW and RedisFDW modules remain for now so existing configs keep working. New branches-to-build tags UNRELEASED and HEAD_PLUS_UNRELEASED , covering branches between the time the tree is forked and a release is tagged.
